g.text: Clock-driven: an action starts at max(planned t, end of the AGV's previous action). ADG-driven: the original ADG of figure 2.4 (with waits); an action starts as soon as all incoming edges come from completed actions. Timings are illustrative; computed

g.text: Same plan, same disturbance: A2-1 (AGV-2 drives W41 → W22) takes 2.5 s instead of 1 s. Every other action takes 1 s. In (a) AGV-3 and AGV-4 keep to the timetable and drive into the junction while AGV-2 is still

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: in it. In (b) nobody enters before the previous AGV has completely left.
